affected.note: Medical claim data from October 2013 (32,087 records) held by a second-tier contractor. No sign of the data circulating online had been found at the time of the notice.

summary.en: Kubota Health Insurance Society said Hirokei, a subcontractor of its system vendor Kansai Information Center, was hit by ransomware and a server holding the society's data had been accessed from outside. Medical claim data of 16,022 insured people, including names, birthdates and treatment details, may have leaked.
summary.ja: クボタ健康保険組合は、システム委託先の関西情報センターの再委託先であるヒロケイがランサムウェア攻撃を受け、同組合のデータを保存したサーバに外部からのアクセス痕跡が見つかったと公表した。氏名、生年月日、受診内容などを含む被保険者16,022人分の診療データが流出した可能性がある。
